name: density
title: Density
summary: How tightly a screen is set: regular for pages and touch, compact for desktop tools.
use: regular for pages, documents and touch screens: 17pt reading and 44pt targets.
compact for tools people work in for hours with a pointer, such as editors and consoles: 13pt reading and 28pt targets.
anatomy: A density set once at the root
Every component reading its sizes from it

options.name: density
options.description: Set once for a whole window. Never mix densities in one screen.

rules: Compact keeps every role, ratio and rule; only sizes shrink: reading 13, small 11, label 10, title 17, control 13, target 28.
Compact is for pointer-driven desktop tools only. Touch screens stay regular.
accessibility: Compact targets are 28pt, the desktop pointer minimum; keep every action reachable by keyboard.
Text follows the platform's text size setting at both densities.
